_comment: The tick query set shared by bench/oracle (correctness) and bench/compare (timing).
Each dialect file (ankaa.sql, duckdb.sql, clickhouse.sql, questdb.sql) holds one block per query id,
introduced by a line `-- @query <id>`. Placeholders {T0} and {T1} are the time-range bounds
(rendered per engine by harness code; see bench/compare/harness/queries.py).
compare.keys: columns identifying a row (results are sorted by them before diffing).
compare.exact: integer / timestamp columns compared exactly.
compare.approx: float columns compared with a relative tolerance.
compare.quantile: columns produced by a sketch, compared within PERCENTILE_ALPHA (0.01) relative.
timing: whether bench/compare/run.py times this query (row-level ASOF outputs are verified but
not timed, because result transfer would dominate; their aggregate twins are timed).
engine_overrides: looser rules for engines that cannot express a column exactly (documented in README).

queries.title: Time-range filter + aggregate
queries.description: Count, volume and price extremes of trades in [T0, T1).

queries.title: GROUP BY symbol
queries.description: Per-symbol trade count, min/max price, volume, first/last timestamp.

queries.title: Latest trade per symbol
queries.description: The last trade (max seq) of every symbol.

queries.title: VWAP per symbol
queries.description: Volume-weighted average price per symbol in [T0, T1), as a double in price units.

queries.title: OHLCV, 1 s buckets
queries.description: Open/high/low/close/volume/notional/count per symbol and 1 s bucket (left-closed, calendar aligned).

queries.title: OHLCV, 5 s buckets
queries.description: Same as q05 at 5 s.

queries.title: ASOF trades -> quotes, backward, no tolerance
queries.description: Each trade joined to the last quote with quote.ts <= trade.ts for the same symbol (row level).

queries.title: ASOF backward, tolerance 100 ms
queries.description: As q07 but the match is dropped (NULL) when trade.ts - quote.ts > 100 ms.

queries.title: ASOF forward, tolerance 1 s
queries.description: Each trade joined to the first quote with quote.ts >= trade.ts, within 1 s.

queries.title: Crossed / locked quotes
queries.description: Number of top-of-book samples with bid >= ask (expected 0 on clean data).

queries.title: Spread statistics
queries.description: Per symbol: quote count, min/max/sum of (ask - bid), average spread and average top depth.

queries.title: Percentiles of price per symbol
queries.description: count/min/max and p50/p90/p99 of trade price per symbol (ANKAA: UDDSketch, 1 % relative error).

queries.title: Percentiles of trade size, all symbols
queries.description: count/min/max and p50/p95/p99 of trade size over the whole table.

queries.title: Trades per second
queries.description: Trade count and volume per 1 s bucket, all symbols together.

queries.title: L2 delta statistics
queries.description: Per symbol and side: delta count, level deletions (size = 0), last update id.

queries.title: Join symbols + range + aggregate
queries.description: Trades per symbol name in [T0, T1) with price range in units.

queries.title: Filter: large trades
queries.description: Trades with size >= 0.05 (5e6 in fixed point), in time order.

queries.title: ASOF backward (aggregated)
queries.description: Timed twin of q07: number of trades, matched trades, sum of quoted spread at trade time.

queries.title: ASOF backward, tolerance 100 ms (aggregated)
queries.description: Timed twin of q08.

queries.title: ASOF forward, tolerance 1 s (aggregated)
queries.description: Timed twin of q09.
